placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Which service each node is holding. A service is pinned to its node as soon as it has a volume, so nothing here moves on its own - draining a node means moving what is on it, one decision at a time.
placement.empty.title: Nothing is placed
placement.empty.description: No service has been scheduled onto a node yet. Create a service and start it, and it will appear here on the node the scheduler picks.
placement.idle.title: Holding nothing
placement.idle.description: Schedulable and empty. New services land here first.
placement.migrate.title: Move {service}
placement.migrate.dataWarning.bold: The data does not move with it.
placement.migrate.dataWarning.suffix: The new node starts with empty volumes, and recovering the contents means restoring a backup onto it.
placement.migrate.checkbox: I accept that the data stays on the old node
placement.migrate.field.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit trail and in the placement itself. Optional, and worth writing.
placement.migrate.field.reasonPlaceholde: draining node-3 for a disk swap
placement.migrate.headroom.text3: of disk free, after the reserve the scheduler keeps back.
